## Goal
**Objective:** Short sentence describing what to finish in 3 hours.

## Tasks (3-hour checklist)
- [ ] 15m — Plan & create branch `feat/day-{{day}}-{{slug}}`
- [ ] 90–120m — Implement feature / tests / docs
- [ ] 30m — Commit, push, open PR, link to issue
- [ ] 15–30m — Update issue, move card, note blockers

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Code compiles and tests pass locally
- [ ] README or API example updated if applicable
- [ ] PR opened and linked to this issue
